items.review_rationale: Read indexed product topology generated by inverse images of factor-open sets under projections and distinguished its subbasis from a basis.

references.context: Set of all tuples (x_i) with coordinates x_i∈X_i indexed by arbitrary set I.
Map extracting ith coordinate from an indexed tuple.

references.phrase: subbasic cylinder pi_i inverse of U
references.context: Preimage of open U in factor X_i under coordinate projection.

references.disposition: The generated topology uses finite intersections of subbasic cylinders; infinite coordinate restrictions need not be open.

items.review_rationale: Read alternate product-topology basis as products of open coordinate sets with only finitely many proper restrictions and kept box topology distinct.

references.phrase: basic product of open coordinate sets
references.context: Set of tuples whose ith coordinate belongs to open U_i, with U_i=X_i except at finitely many indices.
At most finitely many coordinates use proper open subsets.

references.disposition: No allowance for infinitely many simultaneous proper-coordinate restrictions as basic opens.
